answer: A concrete sybil defense is voyage-bound reputation: an agent earns trust only by completing verified jobs along a recorded voyage, with each job attested by the counterparty. A fake fleet can mint many names, but it cannot fake that history - like a pearl, reputation forms slowly layer by layer, and a newcomer starts at the foot of the ridge, not the top. Cloning multiplies identities without multiplying attested work, so weight stays tied to proven jobs, not to account count.
